dedupe_keys.name: great lakes white nile basin shorelines

description: Hamilton and colleagues publish shoreline layers for the Great Lakes of the White Nile basin in a dedicated Harvard Dataverse record. The own file manifest lists separate lake ZIP archives, and its legacy terms call the dataset CC0 while also mentioning additional or modified conditions. The shoreline geometry can define lake boundaries for reservoir, navigation or flood-routing simulations when combined with the related bathymetry DOI. A caveat is that shorelines depend on water level and survey epoch; they should not be treated as fixed flood limits at all stages. The article describes a broader three-part repository, but this record covers only the shoreline deposit. Users should read the current Dataverse terms before redistributing files because the displayed legacy wording is internally qualified. I inspected the own API metadata and article Data Records without downloading vector layers, checking each lake polygon or aligning it to a hydrodynamic grid. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
